name: highlighter
title: Highlighter
description: A hand-drawn mark is scribbled over part of a sentence: marker highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through, crossed-off or bracket, drawn stroke by stroke with a slightly wobbly line.
useWhen: One phrase in a sentence needs a hand-drawn emphasis mark that draws itself on.
An explainer line should look annotated, like marker on paper.
avoidWhen: You want a clean rectangular highlight bar: use inline-highlight.
The mark should follow a moving target or cursor.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text before
variables.description: Plain text before the marked phrase.

variables.label: Marked phrase
variables.description: The phrase that receives the hand-drawn mark.

variables.label: Text after
variables.description: Plain text after the marked phrase.
variables.default: makes important text stand out effortlessly.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels. The paragraph wraps inside 86 % of the frame width.

variables.label: Stroke width
variables.description: Line width of the mark in pixels (source 1.5; scaled with the text here). Ignored by highlight, which fills the text height.

variables.label: Passes
variables.description: How many times the mark is drawn over itself.

variables.label: Padding
variables.description: Space between the text and the mark, in pixels (source 2).

variables.label: Draw time
variables.description: Seconds the whole mark takes to draw (the source uses 0.6).

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Seconds before the mark starts to draw.
